themes.label: Core Inflation Trajectory - December Hike Locked; 2027 Path Now the Question
themes.stance: December hike priced at 91.5% (up from 88%). 2Y at 4.83% implies two to three more hikes in 2027. Core CPI running 3.7% annualized over three months vs 2.85% YTD; core PCE flat at ~2.9% over three and six months — no new data since last update, trend unchanged. October core CPI 0.30% MoM confirmed stickiness. Labor firm: October payrolls 165k, 3-month avg 137k, unemployment fell to 4.1% (from 4.4% in Feb), continuing claims 1.697M — the 4.4%+ scenario that would soften December hike odds looks unlikely. 2027 path is the operative question.
themes.tell: Dec 10 November CPI core ≤0.20% = 2027 hike path reprices lower, close long TIP/short IEF. Dec 15-16 FOMC median 2027 dot above 4.50% = confirms extended tightening cycle. Dec 4 November payrolls: unemployment 4.4%+ = December hike odds soften, theme collapses.

themes.label: Real Yield Surge - Long TIP/Short IEF; Breakevens Complacent vs Core
themes.stance: 10Y real yield is 2.92%, within 3bp of the decade high of 2.95%, up 51bp over three months (larger than 86% of decade 3-month moves). 5Y breakeven fell to 2.26% (near the 2.21% decade median, down from 2.39% on Nov 3), tracking oil rather than core CPI running 3.7% annualized. Outright TIPS position dropped as a discretionary de-risk before the >2.95% trigger fires — real yields too close to decade high with flat breakevens. Replaced by duration-matched long TIP / short IEF, which pays whether oil spikes or core stays sticky. Avoid ZROZ.
themes.tell: Dec 10 November CPI core above 0.30% with breakevens still flat = long TIP/short IEF trade strengthens. Core ≤0.20% = close the pair. 5Y breakeven recovering above 2.46% = confirms mispricing thesis. Real yields breaking above 2.95% decade high = reassess size of outright duration exposure.

themes.label: Gulf Escalation & Energy Rebuild - Iran Attacks Kuwait/Bahrain; XLE Back to Full
themes.stance: Iran fired on a US base in Kuwait and targets in Bahrain; the US struck Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz. The prior tell ('confirmed strike = press energy') has triggered. Last WTI print ($89.62, Nov 11) predates the escalation and was driven by IEA surplus forecasts — that price does not reflect the new Hormuz risk. 5Y breakeven at 2.26% is tracking oil down, not pricing war risk. XLE rebuilt to full position. Refiners (VLO, MPC) held on cheaper feedstock tailwind. No Russian oil supply relief: Ukraine struck the Kerch bridge and a peace deal is priced at only 3.55%. Dirty-bomb intelligence flagged by US but Rubio says no imminent threat.
themes.tell: WTI sustaining below $90 through the escalation = surplus is winning, trim XLE again. WTI above $110 on supply disruption = size up XLE and energy inflation protection. OPEC+ Nov 30 cut announcement = adds upside pressure. Strait of Hormuz transit disruption confirmed = full energy/inflation overweight justified.

themes.label: Equity-Rate Reconciliation - HY at 3.34%; SPY Puts Trigger Reset to 3.50%
themes.stance: HY spreads are 3.34%, up from the 3.20% low where puts were closed, and up 67bp over three months (90th-percentile 3-month move). Real yields are 2.92%, within 3bp of decade high. Equities are holding: recession odds at ~2.45%, >2.5% GDP year at 50%, and corporate profits (Nov 25) are the next test of whether equities can hold at these real yields. Housing is the first casualty (starts -15% from June, 16th-percentile level). SPY put trigger reset to 3.50% daily close. Stress expressed via underweight long-duration equities (REITs, homebuilders, unprofitable AI).
themes.tell: HY daily close ≥3.50% = reopen SPY puts. Nov 25 Q3 profits weak plus HY at/above 3.50% = confirm hedges. HY falling back below 3.00% with real yields near highs = credit diverging from rates, reassess thesis entirely.

themes.label: AI Trade Bifurcating - NVDA Pair Cut to Half; Governance/China-Revenue Risk Remains
themes.stance: Nvidia beat and raised; stock up ~3% pre-open. Earnings risk is gone. Short NVDA / long AVGO pair cut to half size — earnings beat undercut the near-term short thesis. Remaining risk: governance fight between Huang and board, plus Senate testimony giving Treasury's $12bn China chip-supply questions a public stage. Government stake odds at 4.8%. Board ruled out Huang returning as CEO but Huang signaled willingness to return. Close the pair entirely if Senate testimony passes without China revenue follow-up. AMZN and GOOGL still preferred over MSFT and META on Anthropic stake mark-up at IPO.
themes.tell: Senate testimony passes without China revenue follow-up = close remaining NVDA/AVGO pair. Huang reinstated with Treasury acquiescence = exit pair. Government stake odds rising above 25% or restatement/clawback action = size back up short. AMZN/GOOGL outperform MSFT/META on Anthropic IPO first-trade day = confirms valuation thesis.

themes.label: Anthropic IPO + SpaceX - Dual Supply Drag on AI/Tech Megacaps
themes.stance: Anthropic preparing to price its IPO; market gives 99% odds of a $600B+ debut. SpaceX now 94% odds of largest IPO of 2026 (Starship tower catch reinforces narrative). Dual new-supply drag on megacaps intact. AMZN and GOOGL preferred (Anthropic stake mark-up); MSFT OpenAI stake stays illiquid (OpenAI 2026 IPO ~1.5–2.6% odds). Position sized modestly given market awareness.
themes.tell: Anthropic first trade confirmed and AI megacaps (NVDA/MSFT/META) underperform AMZN/GOOGL on first-trade day = supply drag thesis activates. Anthropic day-one cap below $400B = supply drag overshoots, reassess. SpaceX IPO filing confirmed = size up megacap underweight.

themes.label: Defense Overweight - War Strain + Supplemental Spending Likely; XAR Long
themes.stance: Navy Secretary nominee acknowledged the Iran war is straining military resources, implying munitions replenishment need. Market gives 77% odds the US strikes 8 or more countries in 2026. Democrats now hold 56 Senate seats, increasing war-cost oversight and making 2027 tax cuts effectively dead (corporate tax cuts 9.1%, cap-gains cuts 11.5%), but a supplemental defense spending bill is likely even with oversight pressure. Stay overweight XAR.
themes.tell: Supplemental defense spending bill introduced in Congress = confirms thesis, hold XAR. Gulf escalation de-escalates and US strikes fall below 4 countries = reassess overweight. XAR underperforming broader market 3 months after supplemental bill = exit.

themes.label: Breakeven / TIPS Mispricing - 5Y Breakeven 2.26%; Gap to Core Persists
themes.stance: 5Y breakeven fell to 2.26% (from 2.30%), near the 2.21% decade median and down from 2.39% on Nov 3 — it is tracking oil lower, not the core inflation trend. Gap to 3-month annualized core CPI (3.7%) and core PCE (~2.9%) remains wide but the breakeven is moving in the wrong direction. The outright TIPS position was dropped as a discretionary de-risk; the thesis now lives primarily inside the long TIP / short IEF pair under real-yield-tips-rotation. This standalone theme is fading as it has been subsumed.
themes.tell: 5Y breakeven recovering above 2.46% with oil stabilizing = thesis re-activates as standalone. Dec 10 core CPI ≤0.20% = close long TIP/short IEF, theme resolved. Breakeven falling below 2.10% with core still hot = mispricing extreme, reconsider outright TIPS re-entry.
